name: Request Foods
old_description: Since 1990, Request Foods has been making mouth-watering main dishes, appetizers, desserts, and more for the world’s leading brands, retailers, and restaurants. Along the way, we’ve been actively engaged within the food industry, our community, and supplier network to provide fresh ideas and solutions that provide opportunities for mutual success.
about:
Request Foods was founded in 1990 in Holland, Michigan, as a co-packing and contract manufacturing partner for food brands. The company operates from a 903,000-square-foot facility that houses cooking, blending, freezing, and packing lines.

The company produces nearly 800 custom entrées, side dishes, appetizers, sauces, and desserts, each formulated to specific customer requirements. Its culinary team develops recipes from concept through commercialization, handling processes such as sauce simmering, fresh pasta extrusion from durum semolina, cooking, blending, freezing, and packaging. The facility supports scaled production for startups, private-label programs, and national brands.

Request Foods serves startups and small brands looking to replicate and scale authentic recipes, private-label brands seeking to diversify offerings, and national brands requiring consistent high-volume production. Its customers include retailers, club stores, foodservice operators, and restaurants.

The company emphasizes culinary creativity and dependable consistency, investing in technology to improve capacity, speed, scalability, ingredient freshness, and quality assurance. Beyond production, it offers branding, marketing, distribution, and logistics support, aiming to exceed customer expectations through a mission of continuous excellence.
